name: The Head of the Beast
summary: In Stormwind, The Head of the Beast takes you from Elling Trias to Master Mathias Shaw in Old Town. Your report of Lord Gregor Lescovar’s death confirms your place in Stormwind’s covert intelligence network.

sections.title: A Matter Resolved
sections.body: Elling Trias sends you from the crime scene to Old Town after Lord Lescovar is struck down. His death ends the immediate danger to Stormwind’s leaders. Trias is a cheese merchant and a veteran operative. He warns you not to be distracted by courtly praise.

sections.title: Reporting to the Spymaster
sections.body: Master Mathias Shaw directs Stormwind’s covert apparatus through SI:7 from hidden chambers in Old Town. When you report Lescovar’s death, Shaw recognizes your skill and ruthlessness. He praises your efficiency and thanks you for serving the people of Stormwind.

faq.q: What is the purpose of this quest?
aliases: what do i do in head of the beast
faq.answer: You travel from Elling Trias to Master Mathias Shaw in Stormwind’s Old Town. There, you confirm that Lord Gregor Lescovar has been slain.
Mathias Shaw leads SI:7, Stormwind’s secretive intelligence agency and assassin guild, from Old Town.

faq.q: Why does Elling Trias send you to Shaw instead of the palace guard?
faq.answer: Elling Trias works deep within Stormwind’s intelligence apparatus. Lescovar was a prominent nobleman engaged in high treason, so secrecy helps avoid a public scandal among the palace guard.

faq.q: What threat did Lescovar pose to Stormwind?
faq.answer: Lord Gregor Lescovar plotted with subversive agents against the crown and the capital’s safety. He betrayed the realm from within the nobility.

faq.q: What happens after reporting Lescovar's death?
aliases: next quest after head of the beast
faq.answer: Mathias Shaw prepares to close the book on the conspiracy. He sends you toward the final resolution of the threat looming over Stormwind.

faq.q: Where can Mathias Shaw be found?
faq.answer: Mathias Shaw can be found in SI:7’s command building in Old Town, in the eastern quarters of Stormwind City.

angles.text: As a rogue, reporting directly to Mathias Shaw confirms your reliability to the leader of Stormwind’s foremost shadow organization.
As an Alliance member, you help stabilize the realm by removing corrupt aristocrats from Stormwind during King Varian Wrynn’s deeply destabilizing absence.
